title: Transcript bundle meta.json (G37 D3)
description: One recorded run. `kind` selects the grading contract: a behavioral bundle is graded on all six rubric dimensions, a trigger bundle on activation alone — a correct trigger run for a negative prompt activates nothing, calls nothing and claims nothing, which the behavioral rules would fail three ways.

scenario_id.description: A scenarios.yaml id for a behavioral bundle, or a trigger_corpus.yaml prompt id for a trigger bundle.

hashes.description: Every hash the freshness check reads. Each maps back to a set of skills (D6), so a moved hash always nominates something to re-run.

scenarios.description: Per scenario exercised: manifest record + fixture closure + ground-truth entry.

build.description: Publication-grade bundles only: digest over every input that determines the installed checker — abicheck/ plus pyproject.toml plus resolved runtime dependency versions. Defined by inclusion, so the committed evidence tree is outside it by construction and cannot self-invalidate the gate.

observed_inputs.description: What the centralized accessor recorded this run reading — observed, never self-declared. Completeness is checked against this, so a runner that starts reading a new file cannot leave a fully-hashed declared set behind.

path_mapping.description: Output-isolation substitutions applied to the teed streams, if any. Empty for the filesystem-view mechanism, which needs none. The streams are byte-identical modulo these entries — recorded so the difference is auditable rather than invisible.
